description: This file contains the implementation of the SerializerConfigurationValidator class, which validates serializer configuration in the Orleans framework. It includes logic for analyzing serializer availability and generating detailed error messages if issues are found.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationValidator
classes.description: A class that validates the serializer configuration in Orleans, checking for unserializable or uncopyable types and providing detailed diagnostics.
